title: Air metagenome study in Segovia, Spain
description: Study of the diversity and composition of bioaerosols in the atmosphere of Segovia (Spain) during the month of May of 2017. Objective: to analyse the changes in diversity and composition of three different biological particles: bacteria, fungi and plant at several altitudes (1.5, 130, 500 and 1000 m).
